doc: Reefball by listening (M3-AUD-17; ADR 0031; game/audio/reefball_audio.gd; docs/kb/tech/audio_runtime.md "Reefball"). ReefballAudio watches every node whose script's global class (or a base class, or its `audio_class` meta) has a hook here, connects the signals it has by name and never writes the game. An action: sfx_at plays at a place (the signal's first Vector3 or Node3D argument, else the hooked node), sfx plays flat, crowd moves the stands' beds (murmur, excited or silence; the zone's other beds stay), restore + restore_after_sec bring a crowd state back after that long. on_enter / on_exit: an action when the node is attached or leaves the tree. sphere: the node is the water sphere (centre = its global position, radius from radius_method, else radius_m); swim reads each swimmer (a Node3D in one of swim.groups) against it once a frame: the wall crossed inward plays swim.enter, outward swim.exit (edge_m of hysteresis), and every stroke_m swum inside plays swim.stroke, at the swimmer; a jump over teleport_m is not swum. crowd: the two ambience.json beds and the fades. pending: the class is not on this branch yet; tools/audio/data_check.py skips a pending hook's class and signal names. by: an action picks sub-actions from a signal argument (its key, or whether it equals the watched object's equals_prop). holder_property: the class is a headless object a node holds in that property (ReefballMatch); the holder is watched and the object's signals connected. The naming rite carries its own stands going quiet (sfx_reefball.json), so it silences the beds and brings the murmur back after its 12 s. muffle (M3-AUD-22): while the ear (the viewport's Camera3D when use_camera and there is one, else the first node in ear_groups) is inside a sphere, mix.json's muffle is on for `reason` (the world through water); it lifts when the ear leaves or the sphere goes.

hooks._note: gpu/m3-rnd-01-reefball's render rig: no signals; entry, exit and strokes come from the swimmers' positions

M3-AUD-824: the real match (game/minigames/reefball/reefball_match.gd, M3-RBL-01). It is headless, so the hook watches the node that holds it in `match` (holder_property). The action's sound comes from the result's action; a failed one gasps; a float scored rings the ring's bell, with a cheer for the player's side (player_side) or a groan; the end whistle. The kick-off whistle and the naming rite are the scenes' own (ch07_naming.dlg).
